{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values and their sample_seq
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]

print(f"Number of patients with multiple records: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Max sample_seq for each patient with duplicates:")
print(df[df['patient_id'].isin(duplicates.index)].groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max())"}
